article.headline: Wizards take on the Grizzlies on 7-game skid
article.description: Memphis Grizzlies (9-4, sixth in the Western Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (4-10, 12th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Wizards take on the Grizzlies on 7-game skid
article.linkText: Wizards take on the Grizzlies on 7-game skid
article.story: Memphis Grizzlies (9-4, sixth in the Western Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (4-10, 12th in the Eastern Conference) Washington; Monday, 7 p.m. EST LINE: Grizzlies -3.5; over/under is 229.5 BOTTOM LINE: Washington enters the matchup with Memphis after losing seven games in a row. The Wizards have gone 2-4 at home. Washington ranks third in the Eastern Conference with 49.9 points per game in the paint led by Anthony Davis averaging 14.3. The Grizzlies are 6-0 on the road. Memphis ranks eighth in the Western Conference scoring 47.4 points per game in the paint led by Ty Jerome averaging 9.8. The Wizards average 110.6 points per game, 1.1 fewer points than the 111.7 the Grizzlies allow. The Grizzlies are shooting 47.1% from the field, 1.1% higher than the 46.0% the Wizards' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Davis is averaging 24.7 points and 10.3 rebounds for the Wizards. Kyshawn George is averaging 17.6 points over the last 10 games. Cameron Boozer is averaging 15.5 points, 9.7 rebounds and 5.2 assists for the Grizzlies. Cedric Coward is averaging 14.1 points, 8.8 rebounds, 3.4 assists and 1.7 steals over the past 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Wizards: 2-8, averaging 109.2 points, 42.2 rebounds, 23.6 assists, 7.6 steals and 5.6 blocks per game while shooting 45.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 119.4 points per game. Grizzlies: 6-4, averaging 121.1 points, 45.8 rebounds, 28.8 assists, 6.5 steals and 4.5 blocks per game while shooting 47.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.9 points. INJURIES: Wizards: Tre Johnson: out (back), Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: out (foot), Reece Beekman: out (shoulder). Grizzlies: Quinten Post: day to day (concussion protocol), Isaiah Stewart: day to day (illness), Scotty Pippen Jr.: out (back), GG Jackson: out (foot), Ty Jerome: out (hip), Zach Edey: day to day (ankle), Richie Saunders: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
